replyAnchor: User requested: 'Implement this roadmap fully, in one pass' after explicitly requiring due diligence about keeping superior existing implementations instead of blindly replacing them.
implementationSurface: actual product code + tests + smoke/browser proof + updated surface matrix + supervisor/completion artifacts
preservationRules: Do not duplicate or replace an existing superior implementation just because the roadmap listed it as a gap.
Treat package-level route catalogs, fixtures, and tests as evidence of partial implementation; audit them before adding new surfaces.
Prefer integrating and deepening existing package surfaces into the primary app shell over creating parallel substitute systems.
Do not claim completion for any gap family unless product-surface files, executable tests, and parity evidence all exist.
